summary: Who gets the work: {the project} was contracted before you took office, and almost none of the work goes to {the left out}.
realLife: In 1975 Atlanta's mayor halted work and withheld payment on the airport expansion to bring minority firms into its contracts. Despite pushback from business and state leaders, work resumed with a required minority share, and by 1980 minority firms did about a quarter of the work.
gates: {the project} is on record with contracts {the left out} had no part in.
choices: stop the work until the contracts are redone
set a share for new contracts only
let it go ahead and fight later

branches.when: business and state leaders push back
branches.then: Lawsuits threaten, and the work sits idle.

branches.when: the work resumes with a share
branches.then: Years later, the share of work those firms did is the record.
